maya: quick checklist for new model 'koda-6b' initial dev/stg pass — posting a mini-playbook, please run the basics and flag anything weird. steps: 1) curl the /generate endpoint with a few prompts; 2) run int8 quant probe; 3) tokenization edgecases; 4) small evals for facts/math. baseline: correct short facts, <10% repetition on 50-token tasks, coherence on Q/A. tagging @devon @liam @sophie :eyes:

devon: on it. spinning a staging bundle and will drop the endpoint here in ~10m.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: instance for koda-6b (devstg) queued — build 3247. status: building.

devon: endpoint placeholder -> https://devstg.internal/koda-6b (auth via secret-manager). curl example below.

devon: ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -X POST -d '{"prompt":"Q: Who wrote 1984? A:"}' https://devstg.internal/koda-6b/generate
```

liam: running quant/int8 probe with the harness (3 seeds). will capture latency, perplexity, and token-dup metrics. note: may need per-channel quant for first layers.

sophie: running tokenization edgecases + small math set. is the model using sentencepiece? any special detokenize flags?

maya: yes, spm-32000 with hyphen handling. set detokenize=true for evals. start evals with 'factset_v1' and 'household_math_small'.

devon: deploy-bot: build 3247 -> succeeded. endpoint is live at https://devstg.internal/koda-6b/generate. doing quick sanity calls.

devon: quick sanity: Q:"Who wrote 1984?" -> "George Orwell". Q:"What is the capital of France?" -> "Paris". ran a 50-token completion test and saw looping start ~120 tokens (beyond our target), logging it.

liam: quant results (first pass): int8 avg latency down ~35%, perplexity +0.6 on factset_v1, token duplication increased 3%->9% on long-form. logs at /mnt/models/koda6b/int8-run1.log. trying per-channel quant on layers 0-2 next.

sophie: tokenization edgecases: 'mango-juice' -> ["mango","-","juice"] which leads to extra spaces after detokenize. small postprocess will fix. math small: simple multiplications okay. posted a tiny fix.

maya: action items: 1) @devon enable prefix KV caching in devstg; 2) @liam rerun quant with per-channel for first 2 layers; 3) @sophie add detokenize posthook to preprocess. if reruns look good, move to dedicated onboarding queue. ack? :thumbsup:

devon: ack. enabling KV cache now.

cache-bot: cache-bot: KV cache enabled for koda-6b devstg.

liam: starting rerun with per-channel quant on layers 0-2, three seeds. will post summary in ~30m.

sophie: added posthook: small sed to recombine hyphen tokens, pushed to staging preprocess repo: https://git.internal/rdw/preprocess/commit/abc123

maya: thanks. adding a regression test for an Euler-related factual prompt that earlier showed mild hallucination. leaving this thread open until rerun summary posted.
